items.title: MOS Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Higher Costs, Lower Volumes
items.summary: The Mosaic Company (MOS) reported a Q3 2026 net loss of 23 cents per share, wider than consensus estimates, as net sales declined 10.2% year-over-year to $3.1 billion. Lower sales volumes across all segments and higher raw material costs pressured results, though the company beat revenue expectations. MOS expects continued cost pressures in Q4 2026 and revised full-year potash production guidance downward to 8.6 million tons due to lower ore grades.
